name: Wrenn
aliases: the sprout that used to be Wrenn
description: Wrenn is a dryad planeswalker who bonds with treefolk hosts to travel the planes and carries a fire she absorbed to save her forest, known for swapping Zhalfir and New Phyrexia at the cost of her life.

bio.text: Her spark ignited when fire threatened her forest and she pulled it into herself, then she merged with a tree and found she could control the fire.

bio.text: On Innistrad she left her host Six as an oak, met Teferi, helped him undo a tangled time spell, and bonded with a sapling she named Seven.

bio.text: Carried to Realmbreaker by Chandra, Koth and the Mirrans, Wrenn bonded with it despite its rejection, named it Eight, and called to Teferi.

citations.text: "Wrenn", section "New Phyrexia's invasion of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She opened a portal that brought Teferi and the Zhalfirin army to New Phyrexia and swapped the places of Zhalfir and New Phyrexia, and the strain made her fire burn her into an ashen statue.

timeline.summary: Wrenn explains to Teferi how he could unravel his spells and promises to help return Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: she explained how he could unravel his spells and promised to help him with returning Zhalfir

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Realmbreaker swap New Phyrexia's and Zhalfir's places, making Zhalfir a plane of its own and bringing Mirrodin's suns to its sky.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Realmbreaker swapped New Phyrexia's and Zhalfir's places in the Multiverse

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Found and returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirran survivors are welcomed into Zhalfir as refugees through the Omenpath Wrenn opened.
timeline.quote: The survivors of Mirrodin have been welcomed into the new plane as refugees

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Found and returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Connected to the Multiverse through Realmbreaker, Wrenn claims to be the nexus of all that is.
timeline.quote: the nexus of all that is

citation.text: "Multiverse", section "Nexus of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn's spark ignites when a forest fire threatens her sisters; she contains the fire within herself and must share it with a tree.
timeline.quote: Wrenn's spark ignited when a forest fire threatened the lives of her sisters.

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn finds her first host, One, on her homeworld, which lets her planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Wrenn found her first (named by her One ) host on her homeworld.

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Six arrive in the Kessig forest near where they first met.
timeline.quote: put their massive foot down on the soil of Innistrad, deep within the Kessig forest

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn uproots herself from Six, who becomes an oak, ending their partnership.
timeline.quote: she uprooted herself and was no longer joined with Six

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn promises to return someday to find Six and offer his acorns the same choice.
timeline.quote: I will walk these woods again, and I will find you, old friend

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn wanders the forest following treesong toward a possible new partner.
timeline.quote: following the whisper of treesong that told her there was a viable partner growing here

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi, drifting away from the cathars, finds a pale woman speaking to an oak.
timeline.quote: paused when he saw the figure standing in the shadow of one of the great oaks

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn explains a fire devoured her people's trees until she pulled it into herself, where it still burns.
timeline.quote: It devoured the trees of my people, until I found a way to pull it into myself.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Hearing the cathars, Wrenn suspects Teferi lured her and summons fire.
timeline.quote: So you were a lure to call and catch me, then?

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi offers Wrenn his arm and they walk deeper into the forest to avoid the cathars.
timeline.quote: Then we walk.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi senses an unseen presence following them.
timeline.quote: We're being followed,

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi's blue magic reveals a twisted humanoid, which he banishes in a burst of necrotic energy.
timeline.quote: finally vanished in a burst of terrible, necrotic energy

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The path behind them has become a tangle of identical branching paths crackling with time magic.
timeline.quote: The distinctive crackle of time magic hung over it all.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn laments that the tree that called her is gone.
timeline.quote: The tree that called me is gone.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: They exchange names, and Wrenn says she has heard of Teferi's legend.
timeline.quote: They call me Wrenn.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn says she will trust Teferi for now, admitting she will die without a tree.
timeline.quote: I will trust you for now.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: After hours of walking, Wrenn points out they are looping back toward where they began.
timeline.quote: We've made a big loop.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn lends her natural magic so Teferi can hold his tangled spell.
timeline.quote: She hummed, a single clear, carrying note, and the natural magic of the wood swirled around him

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi unmakes the tangled spell by following Wrenn's advice and restores the path.
timeline.quote: Bit by bit, he straightened and unbent the cogs, repairing the spell's original intent

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn walks to an oak and dives into it, finding the sapling that sang to her.
timeline.quote: Wrenn was walking, step by unsteady step, toward that tree.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The tree unfolds into a slumbering treefolk with Wrenn joined to its chest.
timeline.quote: it unfolded into the model of a man, a slumbering treefolk in the process of waking

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi that Seven is grateful because his bent time ripened the sapling.
timeline.quote: Seven says they are grateful for what you've done

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn leaves with Seven to show it lands outside Innistrad.
timeline.quote: I have promised Seven lands outside of Innistrad, and I must keep my word.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi meets Wrenn on Innistrad and they are trapped in a time loop he later undoes.
timeline.quote: trapping him and Wrenn in a loop of time

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Innistrad, after leaving Six as an oak, Wrenn seeks a new host and is intercepted by Teferi, who recognizes her as a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: she was intercepted by Teferi .

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn grants Teferi insight into metamagic so he can see and undo his corrupted time spell; her sapling has gathered all the time it could contain.
timeline.quote: Wrenn's sapling had gathered all the time it could contain.

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn meets a fully grown Seven and promises Teferi to help undo Zhalfir's phasing after showing Seven the multiverse.
timeline.quote: Wrenn met a now fully grown Seven .

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn says the seeds waited for the sun to rise again and are now rewarded.
timeline.quote: These seeds waited faithfully for the sun to rise again.

citation.text: Splendid Reclamation (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Wrenn notes the forests of this world are unafraid to assert themselves.
timeline.quote: The forests of this world are unafraid to assert themselves.

citation.text: Crushing Canopy (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana defends Strixhaven rather than joining the raid on New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: she left to defend Strixhaven despite Chandra's pleas to join her raid on New Phyrexia

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi confesses to Wrenn how he took Zhalfir away from Urza's war and calls himself the true heir to Urza's mantle.
timeline.quote: Then I siphoned energy from the closed portal to fuel a spell spiriting Zhalfir away from space and time itself.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi she is not here to absolve him.
timeline.quote: I am not here to provide you absolution, mage.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Elspeth she lives two melodies, one in light and one in shadow, and Elspeth angrily denies it.
timeline.quote: It is as if you live two separate lives. One in light, one in shadow.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Wrenn senses visitors, and Elspeth confronts two figures glowing green in the rain.
timeline.quote: Are you Elspeth?

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian skyship overpowers the watchtowers, and Elspeth orders Wrenn and Nissa to protect Teferi.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Nissa, protect Teferi at all costs.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: At night Nissa, Wrenn and construct guardians hold the tower hall against Phyrexians who cross the threshold.
timeline.quote: Over two dozen Phyrexians had met with similar fates in the tower hall

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: A pillar of light scorches the sky and steam covers the vale, leaving Elspeth and Jodah's fate unknown.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, a pillar of light scorched the sky outside the tower like a sun ascending

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Nissa commands the mechanical soldiers to meet the army, but nature spirits refuse her call and leylines are tangled.
timeline.quote: They recoiled at her presence.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The constructs and Phyrexians clash, and the Phyrexians fight with unusual tactics, pinning the machines.
timeline.quote: The armies collided with sharp staccato thunderclaps.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Nissa lends Wrenn and Seven her strength and Seven hurls her at the flying Phyrexian general, whom she stabs repeatedly with a seed-bearing sword.
timeline.quote: With each stab, she'd implanted a seed within the Phyrexian

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Nissa kills the crippled Phyrexian general with vines, after Wrenn urges her to stop, deciding she must be decisive when the time comes.
timeline.quote: The vines obeyed her command.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
timeline.quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Wrenn warns them not to disturb the capsule where Teferi is fading across time; Kaya says she can get the sylex to work.
timeline.quote: Teferi's chord is still tethered to this device,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Wrenn, Koth and Urabrask invade the inner spheres but are defeated at the Fair Basilica; Elspeth bursts from the Blind Eternities to save them.
timeline.quote: the newly anointed archangel Elspeth burst from the Blind Eternities, giving the planeswalkers time to escape

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Final Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirran rebels raise a barrier while Wrenn fuses with Realmbreaker to reach Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Successfully merging herself with the cosmic tree, Wrenn reached out across the Multiverse

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Final Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norn flings Elspeth through the barrier, shattering it, as Wrenn opens a portal summoning Teferi and the Zhalfiran army.
timeline.quote: Norn finally seized the angel planeswalker and flung her body through the barrier, shattering it.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Final Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfiran army turns the tide, Vorinclex is killed, and Wrenn shifts Zhalfir into New Phyrexia's place in the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: The Green Praetor Vorinclex was soon killed in the melee

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Wrenn refuse Realmbreaker with Elspeth's return as an archangel; Norn's demise neutralizes the Phyrexians, but the Desparkening costs many their spark.
timeline.quote: Chandra and Wrenn went to New Phyrexia in a second attempt to refuse Realmbreaker, which was successful with Elspeth's return as an archangel

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Compleated Nissa stops Chandra, Wrenn and Seven and tears Seven apart.
timeline.quote: it was Nissa who stopped them and tore Seven apart limb from limb

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn bonds with Realmbreaker and uses its portals to reach Zhalfir and Teferi.
timeline.quote: Wrenn bonds with Realmbreaker and uses its interplanar portals to reach Zhalfir and Teferi .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urabrask helps Chandra and Wrenn and a Mirran squadron reach Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: Urabrask helped Chandra and Wrenn

citation.text: "Urabrask", section "Against New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi recruits Wrenn on Cridhe to fight the Phyrexians; the group gathers on Dominaria and settles in Urza's Tower.
timeline.quote: Wrenn was recruited by Teferi to join the fight against the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Seven help Nissa Revane fend off Phyrexians attacking Urza's Tower and the Temporal Anchor, then help recover Teferi.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Seven helped Nissa Revane fend off the second line of Phyrexians attacking the tower

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers wait in Liliana's safe house on Dominaria for two weeks of word from the strike team.
timeline.quote: For two weeks they'll wait here in one of Liliana's cabins on Dominaria.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Chandra coaches Wrenn on controlling her inner fire and recalls Jaya's teachings and Ajani's killing of Jaya.
timeline.quote: Jaya's dead, Ajani killed her

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Tyvar's arrival heralds the return of survivors from New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the brash war-horn boom of Tyvar's arrival falls like an axe between them

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Wrenn joins Chandra, saying the World Tree is alive and that she can reach Teferi with Chandra's fire and the World Tree's power.
timeline.quote: The others were wrong—that tree is alive.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Wrenn and Seven leave to head for New Phyrexia while unseen watchers observe them.
timeline.quote: Let's head out.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Unseen watchers declare they are there to witness the beginning of the end.
timeline.quote: We are here to witness the beginning of the end.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Wrenn arrive on New Phyrexia and find a bright landscape dominated by a vast Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: Chandra can't comprehend how tall the Invasion Tree is.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They find Mirran survivors under Koth and Melira, and Chandra pitches that Wrenn will bond with the tree to guide it.
timeline.quote: We'll head for the tree. Once we're there, I'll attach myself to him, and try to guide him,

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth says Karn was taken near the tree and agrees to try to take control of the tree and rescue him.
timeline.quote: We may as well try to gain control of the tree and rescue him at the same time.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They plan to have Koth launch Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm while the Mirrans distract Norn.
timeline.quote: The rest of the Mirrans will provide a tantalizing distraction for the so-called Mother of Machines.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth launches Chandra and Wrenn through the air, and bladed bats attack.
timeline.quote: Koth drives his fist into the earth.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Chandra lands hard on the tree and Wrenn prepares to bond while centurions form around them.
timeline.quote: Plates along the tree shift and reform.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Centurions speak with one woman's voice and spears pin Chandra to the tree while Phyrexian Nissa attacks Wrenn.
timeline.quote: Green magic crackles around her metallic body, her four arms all acting as conduits.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nissa tears Seven apart and drops Wrenn, saying she no longer feels pain.
timeline.quote: I no longer feel any pain.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nissa has copper branches seize Wrenn, whom she calls a fine guardian for Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: You will make a fine guardian for Realmbreaker,

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.
